_column_contract: Summit's cover box runs Current | Last(=Previous, 2024 sheet) | Cumulative — the REVERSE of the parsed cities' sheet. All three columns are captured VERBATIM and LABELLED here; the builder promotes one per the rule documented in CLAUDE.md. "" = the cell was EMPTY (or a slashed-zero / dash nil mark) on the form; null = a value is present but ILLEGIBLE and was never guessed.
method: vision via the Read tool on a pdftoppm -jpeg -r 200 render of page 1 cropped to the top 80% ($0 API; Claude Code allotment)
notes: Typed 2022 single-total sheet; the county REDACTED the address and part of the phone line on the published PDF (black marker). The campaign-balance CUMULATIVE cell is EMPTY and the Last Report cell prints $850.21 while the other Last cells print $0.00 — filer inconsistency, retained. Signature date line blank.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: p2+p3 are ONE contribution schedule (p3 is the continuation sheet, same column header, no title); the schedule's own printed grand total sits under the p3 grid: '$16,427.00', and the 57 rows (44 on p2 + 13 on p3) reproduce it to the cent AND match the cover's cumulative contribution figure. p4+p5 are ONE expense schedule (p5 is the continuation sheet); its printed grand total under the p5 grid is '$13,792.07' and the 72 rows (43 on p4 + 29 on p5) reproduce it to the cent AND match the cover. No specimen rows on this filing - the filer built his own spreadsheet rather than typing into the county's blank form.

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: Canice Harte, County Council, 2022 Pre-Election. Filer-built typed spreadsheet (NOT the county's blank form), 5 pages: p1 cover, p2-p3 Itemized Contribution Report, p4-p5 Itemized Expense Report. No embedded text layer at all (draft.py returned zero lines on every page - this county scan carries no OCR), so all four ledger pages were read full-page at 200 dpi. ADDRESSES ARE REDACTED BY THE COUNTY, NOT LEFT EMPTY BY THE FILER: the Mailing Address / City / State / Zip Code columns are printed on both contribution pages with their headers intact, and every data row's cells in those four columns have been erased/whited-out, leaving faint residual glyph fragments visible inside the cells (e.g. 'PU RC' surviving in the Rusty Dassing address cell on p3, stray digits at the right edge of several zip cells). donor_city / donor_state are therefore honestly BLANK on all 57 rows. SOURCE PROPERTY THE BRIEF DOES NOT LIST: the EXPENSE sheet's title line reads '2020 CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL REPORT' while the contribution sheet reads 'Campaign Financial Report 2022' - the filer reused his 2020 spreadsheet's expense tab and left its title's year stale. Every expense DATE on the sheet is 2022 and the total matches the 2022 cover, so this is a stale template heading, not a 2020 ledger; nothing was repaired. GEOMETRY: rowbands' detected bands are CONTAMINATED on all four pages (p2 reports 46 bands over 44 rows with heights from 0.40 to 4.69 - text lines registering as rules while several real rules are missed), so both sides ship on force_declared frames. The frames are measurements: fitting a regular grid to the table-region rules gives pitch 1.700 on p2 (43/43 rules explained), 1.680 on p4 (43/43) and 1.674 on p5 (30/30), and each side's two pages sit on ONE shared grid whose phase was solved jointly so the worst-case row offset is 0.20pct on a 1.70pct-tall box. Contribution bands: p2 rows are bands 6-49, p3 rows are bands 1-13. Expense bands: p4 rows are bands 8-50, p5 rows are bands 1-29. Verified end to end at 500 dpi: band 6 -> '2/12/22 Canice Harte $25.00', band 49 -> '9/20/22 Katy Lillquist $50.00', p3 band 1 -> '9/20/22 Park City Board of Realtors $5,000.00', p3 band 13 -> '10/26/22 Todd Rooney $50.00', expense band 8 -> '2/28/22 Summit County Clerk / Campaign filing fee / $303.02', band 50 -> '8/18/22 Google Domains / Campaign website / $12.96', p5 band 29 -> '10/28/22 Meta / Advertising / $250.00'.
